projection_model: fixed Figure 2F early KMeans K=3 model
local_profile: center spot plus five nearest spots, arithmetic mean
transform: CLR followed by within-patient median centering
training: up to 800 early spots per patient with equal patient weight
ood_definition: distance to assigned early centroid exceeds the cluster-specific 99th percentile among early spots
heatmap: patient-level log2 observed/expected among in-distribution projected spots; group median across six patients
dot_definition: same enrichment direction in >=5/6 patients and absolute median log2(Ro/e) >= 0.15
stage_test: two-sided exact Mann-Whitney U on patient-level nearest-niche fractions; BH across three niches
interpretation: Projection tests preservation or redistribution of early composition-defined niches; it does not define new advanced-specific functional niches
